widgets_values:
You have multiple ways to use this worklfow:

Text to Image
Text to Image using Florence caption from your input image, 
Image to image
Image to image first Ksampler bypass, if you only want to upscale and face enhance the image without changing it too much.
Image to image first Ksampler bypass, "Flux Cnet Upscale" group bypass, to only use the face enhance part.

Since newer T2I models than flux are available, I mostly use this workflow for the flux controlnet upscaler,
 it is still really powerful and not outdated for sure, I use it alot.

You can use the regular Flux model, or Flux KREA, it's up to you. HF
